title: The rundown
note: What's going on right now, in one place. The ↗ links out to the original source; the item's own text turns into a link only once it becomes a full entry here.

items.text: The 2026 Nobel Peace Prize went to Navi Pillay, the South African jurist and former UN human rights chief, announced October 9 in Oslo for decades of work holding perpetrators of war crimes, crimes against humanity and genocide accountable.

Tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz hit a wartime high in the week ending October 4 — eleven vessels struck, per IMO data, the most since the war began in February — even as oil flows through the strait partially rebounded to somewhere between 8.5 and 10.3 million barrels a day depending on the tracker, still 23 to 40 percent below prewar levels.

U.S. stocks closed higher Friday, October 9, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average up 0.8% to 51,655.01, the S&P 500 up 0.6% to about 7,811.5, and the Nasdaq Composite up 0.6%, capping a volatile week heading into earnings season.
Humana shares jumped 13% Friday after an improved Medicare Advantage star rating and an analyst upgrade.

Spain's Pedro Sánchez called a snap election for November 29 after parliament rejected his government's housing decrees, pushing the Spanish 10-year yield up nearly 5 basis points to 4.13% even as French 10-year yields eased to 4.86%, narrowing the spread over German bunds to 138 basis points.
Bitcoin traded around $82,800 on Saturday, October 10, up from about $81,900 a day earlier as the market steadied after this week's Middle East-driven selloff.
Crypto investment funds shed $1.07 billion over the past week, CoinShares reported, ending a six-week streak of inflows as Iran-related geopolitical anxiety weighed on sentiment.

Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5 on October 7, the last model in its 5.5 family, priced about 75% below Haiku 4.5 for high-volume tasks like summarization and classification and available on AWS, Google Cloud and Azure alongside Anthropic's own platform.

OpenAI began rolling out GPT-6 with an "Intelligent UI" mode in ChatGPT on October 7, mixing text answers with tappable buttons, charts, forms and editable diagrams, reaching Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users first and Free and Go users by October 8.

Google made its Nano Banana 2.1 image-generation and editing model generally available in the Gemini API on October 6, replacing Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image), which it will shut off on October 29.

Russia's health watchdog Rospotrebnadzor said October 8 that contact observation around the Irkutsk plague death had ended and the regional quarantine was lifted, while dismissing social-media reports of a second infection as "incorrect"; the WHO said it is still seeking details from Russia.
